content: Format: type/issue-number-description. Types: feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor, test.
Conventional Commits: type(scope): description. Types: feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor, test, perf.
Use winston for Node.js backends, loguru for Python. Do NOT use console.log in production code.
Use Maybe/Option pattern instead of null checks. In TypeScript: ?? and ?. operators preferred.
